findings.claim: update() evaluates the login predicate on the org-aware wrapped 'original' from getById(), whose isEnabled() is false while the linked organization is disabled; if the update also makes the IdP fail the predicate (hideOnLogin, linkOnly, BROKER_PUBLIC removed), registerIDPLoginInvalidationOnUpdate returns early and the ORG_ONLY/ALL login caches are not invalidated. After the org is re-enabled, the stale cached id list surfaces a hidden/link-only/non-public IdP on the login page.
findings.evidence: original comes from getById (line 91) -> createOrganizationAwareIdentityProviderModel (lines 430-445) whose isEnabled() reflects org enabled state; updated comes unwrapped from IdentityProviderResource.updateIdpFromRep -> RepresentationToModel.toModel. Early return at lines 403-407 when both fail the predicate. Org enable/disable (InfinispanOrganizationProvider.registerOrganizationInvalidation) does not touch cacheKeyForLogin keys. getForLogin cached path (lines 244-252) reloads ids via getById and OrganizationAwareIdentityProviderBean:75,80 re-checks only isEnabled(), not hideOnLogin/linkOnly/BROKER_PUBLIC. Proposed red test (not run): fill ORG_ONLY cache, disable org, set hideOnLogin=true on an org IdP, assert cacheKeyForLogin(realm, ORG_ONLY) entry is null (non-null on patched code); re-enable org, assert getForLogin(ORG_ONLY, orgId) excludes the IdP. Reasoned; both correctness seats traced the same path independently.
findings.reason: Two independent correctness seats traced the same concrete path with source citations; evaluate the predicate on the raw stored model (idpDelegate.getById), as remove() already does. Requires a red test before the fix (not run: benchmark mode stops after merge).

findings.claim: getLoginPredicate() is a public SPI predicate; the added 'organizationId == null || BROKER_PUBLIC' clause changes behaviour beyond the cache, notably IdentityProviderBean.federatedProviderPredicate() (used when organizations are off) now hides a user's already-linked org-bound non-public IdP. Unannounced scope beyond the commit title.
findings.evidence: IdentityProviderBean.java:226 uses getLoginPredicate(); FreeMarkerLoginFormsProvider.java:481-485 selects the plain bean when orgs are off; Infinispan provider line 433 does not wrap when the feature is off. CONTRIBUTING.md / PR-CHECKLIST.md: no unrelated changes. Counter-evidence: the OCR seat checked this path and found no practical regression, and OrganizationAwareIdentityProviderBean already applied an equivalent BROKER_PUBLIC check.
findings.reason: Likely intended (needed so invalidation matches what the login query returns) and seats disagree on impact; settle by confirming intent against issue #32573 and the realm-only search path. Advisory/Minor, non-blocking.

findings.claim: ORG_ONLY/ALL login results for all organizations live in one IdentityProviderListQuery per realm+mode; each new org miss invalidates the shared entry (revision bump) and copies the entire previous map (putAll), so the entry grows unbounded, concurrent misses for different orgs defeat addRevisioned, and any login-IdP change drops results for every org.
findings.evidence: Lines 215, 232-241; IdentityProviderListQuery copy constructor uses putAll(previous.searchKeys). getByOrganization keys per org and avoids this. Reasoned, no load test.
findings.reason: Performance under many orgs, not correctness; settle with a load test of concurrent logins across many organizations before re-keying to realm+mode+orgId. ponytail: per-mode entry acceptable until org count is large.
